d:
Angels, humanity’s mortal enemy.
And the only one who can fight against the angels is Shinji.

Shinji put his all into fighting at first, but the stress of putting his life on the line chipped away at his mental strength.

As his arrogance increased, he began threatening the women around him that he would stop fighting if they didn’t listen to what he said.

The women who slept with Shinji had to follow his every command.

That was the beginning of Shinji’s “kingdom,” and no one could go against him because he held the fate of the earth in his hands.
